lifecycleEvidence.decision: Not admitted. Aug 14 report quotes official suspension of minting/redemptions and other functions after reserve impairment. Sep 18 report quotes official Sep 17 limited redemption program operated by Caverna Auctus, fixed against liquid reserves through Nov 14. Oct 20 reporting still identifies recovery redemption at 0.51 USDC. This establishes restricted recovery context, not currently resumed ordinary staking; do not infer ongoing maintenance from stale marketing/docs or exit transactions. This record does not assert a formally announced team disbanding.
lifecycleEvidence.sourceLimitations: Direct X reads were blocked (xAI credentials unavailable); official statements are quoted and linked by readable reports. Official product/docs pages remain online but do not resolve the recovery restrictions.

sourceSemantics.staking: deposit/mint use real ERC4626 inheritance with pause, soft/full blacklist, positive assets/shares and MIN_SHARES checks. Source presence is NOT admission during restricted recovery.
sourceSemantics.exit: cooldownAssets/cooldownShares burn shares and transfer NUSD into immutable Silo; extend shared account cooldown and accumulate claim assets. unstake(receiver) releases full matured account amount. Direct withdraw/redeem revert CooldownOn whenever cooldownDuration != 0. No generic ERC4626 exit substitution.
sourceSemantics.configurationObservation: Explorer read page displayed cooldownDuration=1, paused=false, lastDistributionTimestamp=1786480631. These are third-party displayed values, not fresh RPC checks or evidence that staking has resumed. Official docs elsewhere say 10-day queue and instant router route, so neither historical/default duration is asserted current.
